Sheet has blank ConstructionYear. EIA history shows status remained 'Applied' from 2020-03 through 2021-07, suggesting construction never commenced (no in-service date listed). Phase II was cancelled before construction began. Searched EIA for any construction start date but found none. Recommend checking FERC order to determine if construction was ever authorized or if certificate was cancelled in advance of construction.

Sheet shows StartYear1 = 2023 (a future/proposed in-service date). This is a PROPOSAL-ERA VALUE - Phase II was never built and was cancelled in 2021, so 2023 was the originally-targeted in-service year, not achieved. The value on the sheet is the PROPOSAL TARGET, not a verified historical date. Per rule 5, a proposed project's specs are refs from proposal-era documents. This value needs sourcing to a FERC pre-filing or application statement of the intended in-service year. No secondary sources for a 2023 target found in EIA. Recommend checking FERC docket CP20-47 application documents for the stated in-service date.

Sheet has blank FuelSource. FuelSource typically denotes the commodity extracted (natural gas, gathered from a field; oil; NGLs; etc.) vs. Fuel (the commodity the pipeline carries, which is Gas). No FuelSource found in EIA or secondary sources. For a proposed transmission line like PennEast Phase II, the FuelSource would be blank (interstate transmission serves multiple sources). This appears to be correctly blank.

Sheet has blank SegmentCost. EIA history shows no cost value for Phase II. The Phase I entry in EIA shows cost ~$1300M but Phase II cost is not published in EIA. Searched for press releases and FERC filings but could not locate Phase II cost estimate. Per rule, SegmentCost is only staged when a primary source explicitly states the cost for THIS scope (Phase II, not Phase I or the parent system total). Recommend checking FERC application documents (docket CP20-47) for project cost estimate.

Sheet has blank Pressure (MAOP, Maximum Allowable Operating Pressure). Pressure is typically found in FERC orders and tariff filings. Phase II was cancelled before tariff was finalized. No pressure specification found in EIA or secondary sources. Recommend checking FERC docket CP20-47 application/order documents if any MAOP specification was published.

Sheet has blank Operator. EIA lists 'PennEast Pipeline Co' as the project operator, but this is the project entity, not necessarily the operator of the eventual system (which would have been determined if the project was built). For a cancelled project, an 'Operator' is not applicable. The Owner (PennEast Pipeline Co / its parent entity) is recorded. If the question is who owns/operates PennEast Inc. as the project entity, that is recorded in Owner. Recommend leaving blank (no operating company exists) or note that the project entity is PennEast Pipeline Co.
